research_question: How much credit card debt do Americans carry in 2026, and how should the different averages be read?

research_brief.purpose: Present total, survey-average and bank-level card data with populations stated.
research_brief.audience: US consumers and readers of debt headlines.
research_brief.data_period: NY Fed Q3 2026; SHED 2025 (2023 vs 2025 matched); FRED G.19 Aug 2026; FRED bank delinquency/charge-off Q2 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Sources use different populations; no age table published.

statistics.claim: Card balances $1.285T Q3 2026; +$22B q/q; +$52B y/y; total debt $19.105T; card limits +$115B
SHED matched average balance $7,279 (2025) vs $6,531 (2023); +$748 (11%); by well-being table
Difficult/just getting by = 65% of balance growth (40% prior); living comfortably 3% (about one-fourth prior)
82% had a card in 2025 (84% high in 2021); 45% of owners carried a balance, down 12 pts over decade
Card rate accounts assessed interest 22.36% Aug 2026 (22.83% Aug 2025); all accounts 21.19% (21.39%)
Bank card delinquency 2.85% Q2 2026 (3.04% Q2 2025); charge-off 3.82% (4.19%)
